verdict.rationale: Insomnia supports importing Postman/OpenAPI collections and exporting spec documents for version control, and Kong's Dev Portal lets developers browse/search published API documentation and try operations — together covering spec-design-to-published-docs. But the evidence doesn't show one integrated workflow explicitly generating docs from a collection and publishing them (Dev Portal publishing isn't tied back to Insomnia import/export in the docs). missing for 10: an end-to-end documented workflow linking collection import/spec design to Dev Portal publishing, and independent/hands-on confirmation that generated docs render correctly.
